Original archive records unchanged.

sourceDiscrepancy.en: Archive heading/district say Punyana, Sikar, but the book P234 and original article body say Punana, Jaipur/Jalsu; Census 080280 Punana (2011 Amber) matches Bichpari, Nangal Ladi and Bishanpura. Census 081866 Punyana in Sikar is rejected. Original record unchanged.
